name: Rigel's Big Hand
description:
Concentration, up to one minute.

You create a translucent hand made of pure force in a space within short range. It is as big as you are and is a construct creature. Roll Lore. The hand has Endurance equal to the result, Defense equal to half the result, ranks in Strength equal to one quarter of the result and a number of d12 Engagement dice equal to one eighth of the result. Its Speed is 40 ft and it can fly.

You may use a half action to move the hand up to its speed and allow it to take an action. It can make a melee attack, dealing 4d8 on a hit, or may attempt to grapple, push or otherwise interact with creatures and objects. It is incapable of actions requiring delicate movement. The hand grants half cover when standing behind it.

Describe the hand and how you control it.
successes:
✨: You may add WITS to the hand's damage rolls.

✨: The hand also has ranks in Dexterity equal to one quarter of the Lore roll result and can perform delicate movements and interactions.

🌞: The hand deals an additional 2d8 damage and its Speed increases by 20 ft.

💀: The hand turns against you. It moves to be adjacent to you and makes its melee attack against you, then the spell ends. Check a Condition.
